We experiment with various state-of-the-art pretrained summarization models, namely T5  and BART , and Large Language Models (LLMs) including OpenAI's gpt-3.5-turbo (the model behind Chat-GPT) (OpenAI, 2023) and LMSYS's Vicuna-7B-v1.5 ) (a LLaMA-2  model fine-tuned on ChatGPT conversations). We manually compare five random summaries generated by each model and find that ChatGPT and Vicuna generate coherent summaries that capture the most salient points expressed in the document, while T5 and BART omit important information and generate disconnected sentences that are almost the same as those in the original document.
